laws.rule: LASEPA says Lagos State prohibits smoking in public places, enclosed areas and vehicles where non-smokers may be exposed to cigarette smoke. This is the state regulator summary of the Regulation of Smoking Law. Detailed exceptions, the complete law and penalties are not yet checked.

LASEPA noise guidelines require authorisation for open-air shows and outdoor amplified activities. The agency says religious and entertainment venues should be enclosed and soundproofed. These are regulator guidelines; this record does not claim a general ban on ordinary outdoor conversations or a universal event permit.
